name: Get-Icon
description: Extract, inspect, convert and download the highest-quality icon from any public website. Get Icon analyzes Apple Touch Icons, Web App Manifests, regular favicons and common paths, then verifies real formats and dimensions. Includes batch extraction, multilingual UI, image conversion, caching, rate limiting and SSRF protection.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port for the Get Icon web interface and REST API.

variables.name: Allow DNS fake-IP
variables.description: Keep false on normal networks. Enable only for a trusted Clash 198.18.0.0/15 fake-IP DNS environment.

variables.name: Max outbound requests
variables.description: Maximum concurrent outbound website and icon requests shared by all users.

variables.name: API rate limit
variables.description: Maximum API requests per client IP per minute.

variables.name: Trusted proxy hops
variables.description: Trusted reverse proxy hop count. Keep 1 for a single Caddy or Nginx proxy.
